meta.name: Bhaag Beanie Bhaag
meta.description: Facing disapproving parents, a knotty love life and her own inner critic, an aspiring comic ditches her cushy but unsatisfying life to pursue stand-up.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Unhappy at work and engaged to a man who doesn’t understand her, aspiring stand-up comic Beanie realizes she’s on the fast track to a discontented life.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: As Ravi and Kapi try to get an anxious Beanie back on stage, she deals with the reactions of her boss, parents and Arun to her big decisions.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Despite her parents' concerns, Beanie goes full throttle on her new plans, until Ravi makes her take a day off with him.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Visits with a therapist force Beanie’s parents to face ignored truths. As Beanie begins to let her guard down with Ravi, a discovery throws her off.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Reeling from recent quarrels, Beanie agrees to perform at a wedding, where she runs into some unexpected guests and gets unabashedly real on stage.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Ahead of an exciting opportunity, Beanie considers making peace with her parents, acting on resurfaced feelings and staying true to her dreams.
